summary.text: Christian Vukasovich, a Democrat and a teacher and college professor born in Michigan, lost the November 3, 2026 election for U.S. House in Michigan's 5th District to incumbent Tim Walberg.

paragraphs.text: Christian Vukasovich was born in Michigan and has worked as a teacher and a college professor.
According to his campaign website, he earned bachelor's and master's degrees at Eastern Michigan University and a Ph.D. in media and communication from Bowling Green State University.
The campaign website says he spent nearly two decades teaching at universities and has been a union organizer with the American Association of University Professors.
He was unopposed in the August 4, 2026 Democratic primary and ran against incumbent Tim Walberg.
He received 38.6% of the vote to Tim Walberg's 59.1%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
